key_concepts: Solid materials have definite shape and volume.
Solid materials have properties such as size, shape, color, texture, and weight.
Bending solid materials may change their size and shape.
Bending does not form a new material.
Bending is a physical change because only physical appearance changes.
Bending steel bars or iron is an industrial example of bending solid materials.
Pressing solid materials may change their size and shape.
Pressing some solid materials may also change their texture.
Pressing does not form a new material.
Only physical appearance changes when solid materials are pressed.
